user_saw: If the Control UI failed to start, users saw a standalone recovery card that looked different from the rest of the app.
summary: The fix restyled the static startup fallback to match the Control UI shell and simplified its recovery controls while preserving automatic retries and late startup.
reasoning: The PR describes a visual mismatch, and the diff replaces the recovery card with the approved shell and updates its copy and controls. I checked the preceding holding-screen commit (#191935), which updated the existing card’s messages and action visibility. The startup failure is the condition that displays the fallback, and this change addresses its presentation.
